external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Francisco spent his childhood and teenage years split between Madeira and Lisbon – a hint of what his professional life would look like in a few years. After finishing high school in Madeira, Francisco moved to Lisbon more definitively to study Management at ISEG Lisbon School of Economics and Management, whilst at the same time initiating his career leading the Finance, Legal and Administrative Departments of the Group, headquartered in Madeira Island.

Having completed his studies at Glion in both Switzerland and London campuses, Gonçalo gained valuable experience working in dynamic cities such as Lisbon, Dubai, Barcelona, and London, with a strong focus on hospitality and customer centric roles.

With a background in Marketing and Financial Investments from IADE and the London School of Business and Finance, Filipe serves as Executive Board Member of the Sharing Group responsible for International Sharing School – Madeira.
